name: Cluster API
author: Sextant
description: Cluster API's Clusters, ClusterClasses, KubeadmControlPlanes, MachineDeployments, MachineSets, Machines, MachineHealthChecks and ClusterResourceSets, each with its state from its own phase and conditions; the chain from a Cluster to its Machines, provider objects and Nodes, and the workload cluster opened on a click; problems of failed or unavailable Clusters and control planes, Machines failed or stuck provisioning and blocked remediation. Read-only.
